title: feat(df-ui-bugfix/T6): Kanban feature lifecycle status mapping
body:
## T6 — Kanban feature lifecycle status mapping

### Changes

- Added `isValidFeatureStatus()` type guard that accepts only the 8 canonical feature lifecycle statuses (`in_design`, `in_tdd`, `ready_for_implementation`, `in_implementation`, `in_handoff`, `done`, `blocked`, `cancelled`) and rejects task lifecycle statuses (`todo`, `ready`, `in_progress`, `in_review`)
- Added `normalizeFeatureStatus()` that maps valid statuses through unchanged and falls back to `"in_design"` for invalid values
- Fixed `FeatureBoardView` to stop dynamically adding unknown statuses as Kanban columns — only the 8 lifecycle columns are ever shown
- Added `isValidFeatureStatus` filter in `FeatureBoardView` to exclude features with non-lifecycle statuses from the Kanban grid
- Added 23 focused tests covering:
  - All 8 valid feature lifecycle statuses are accepted by `isValidFeatureStatus`
  - Task lifecycle statuses are rejected
  - `normalizeFeatureStatus` fallback behavior
  - `FEATURE_STATUS_OPTIONS` contract (8 columns, no task statuses)
  - Kanban card status data attributes
  - FeatureRow lifecycle status rendering
  - Regression: task statuses are never shown as feature status

### Test results

- 939 tests pass across 47 test files (0 failures)
- 23 new tests in `t6-kanban-status.test.ts`
